kind: Engine design record with synthetic unit tests and a developer-server run against the retail multiplayer module; behaviour is fnTech3's own design, block meanings are Raven's
incorporation: no implementation text incorporated from any source

boundary.gameOwns: every command that touches an entity; the engine writes a record into the buffer the module lent it (G_SET_SHARED_BUFFER) and calls the module's export with no arguments
boundary.sharedBufferRank: third thing the module asks for

callbackRecords.note: sizes and offsets asserted; most begin with the task identifier then the entity, the two lerp endpoints begin with the entity

blocksOn: a task group (game reports every command finished)
stopsByName: a move in a shape the reader does not know

fixedByScripts.signal: blocks 46 and 47 name each other across scripts of one level

chosenByEngine: a waitsignal consumes the signal it waited for
an affect that names no entity stops the script
a flush clears the sequencer it runs on and the commands the game still owes stop counting against a wait
random uses the engine's own generator, seeded per level
a script that never pauses is stopped after a bounded number of statements
chosenNote: these are not claims about Raven's behaviour; when observable behaviour later contradicts one, the choice should change

stopsAt.message: Jedi Academy game import G_NAV_LOAD (202) is not served yet

retailModuleRun.icarusSurface: init, shutdown, initialized check; four entity calls; run and register; per-entity tick and running check; three task-identifier calls; five variable calls

testsNote: exercised against a host of the test's own making
notShown: no script has been run against the retail module; the module stops at navigation before a level's scripts start
nothing rendered, no entity moved, no client exists
Jedi Outcast ships the same format but nothing has driven its modules; its multiplayer is QVMs and its boundary was not opened
